# opnsense_bind_view (Data Source)

Reads a BIND view by UUID or semantic view name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Legacy UUID lookup.
data "opnsense_bind_view" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}

# Preferred semantic lookup.
data "opnsense_bind_view" "internal" {
  name = "internal"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID selector or resolved UUID of the view.
- `name` (String) Unique semantic BIND view name. Lookup is trimmed and case-insensitive.

### Read-Only

- `allow_query_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `allow_query_any` (Boolean)
- `allow_recursion_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `allow_transfer_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `dnssec_validation` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `forwarders` (Set of String)
- `match_any` (Boolean)
- `match_client_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `match_destination_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `recursion` (Boolean)
- `sequence` (Number)
